propositions: The per-test hang budget was lowered from 300s to 20s in pyproject.toml and both _build-and-test.yml shared lanes, placing it below the measured 18.7–29.93s legitimate cost range of whole-tree-scan tests, causing xdist worker crashes on every CI run.

With timeout_method=thread, pytest-timeout expires tests via os._exit(1) from the watchdog thread, killing the entire xdist worker process and preventing the test harness from reporting Failed: Timeout verdicts.

The Verified gate executes workflow files from trusted main via GitHub reusable-workflow resolution, so a patchset-only fix to _build-and-test.yml timeout flags cannot exercise itself; main's stale CLI --timeout=20 overrides the patchset's ini timeout=300 due to pytest-timeout precedence CLI > INI.

The gating ubuntu-latest py3.13 leg with --cov=rebar reproduces the crashes locally and on CI; coverage adds ~2x cost multiplier, pushing legitimate tests from ~12–15s to 4–6s idle up to 18.7–29.93s under full suite saturation.
Dead workers under --dist loadgroup re-dispatch pending items to respawned workers that crash on the same item, burning restarts up to the job timeout cap and silently dropping test results.

Restoring timeout=300 in both pyproject.toml ini and explicit _build-and-test.yml lane flags provides >10x headroom above measured costs and stabilizes the suite; headroom contract tests enforce the invariant going forward.
